# Callout Conservatory

Callouts have distinct semantic colors, but their spacing, borders, typography,
and surfaces should remain coherent within a theme.

## Informational

> [!note] Note
> A neutral observation with a short body.

> [!info] Information
> Supporting context that should not dominate the page.

> [!abstract] Summary
> A compact summary of a longer idea.

## Positive

> [!tip] Tip
> A practical suggestion for the reader.

> [!success] Success
> The garden built and every expected artifact appeared.

## Attention

> [!important] Important
> A detail that deserves emphasis without implying failure.

> [!warning] Warning
> Something requires care before continuing.

> [!question] Question
> Does the component still read clearly in dark mode?

## Negative

> [!danger] Danger
> A serious condition requiring immediate attention.

> [!failure] Failure
> A result that did not meet its acceptance criteria.

> [!bug] Bug
> A reproducible defect belongs here.

## Supporting

> [!example] Example
> A concrete illustration of the surrounding text.

> [!quote] Quotation
> A highlighted quotation presented as an admonition.

> [!todo] To do
> Review this page in every shipped theme.
